chief_complaint: Hypertension in pregnancy with chronic pain management concerns
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 47‑year‑old pregnant woman (pregnancy onset 2022‑12‑30) who presents with stage 2 hypertension (SBP 149 / DBP 98) currently treated with lisinopril, an ACE‑inhibitor contraindicated in pregnancy. She has chronic low‑back pain and generalized chronic pain managed with ibuprofen 400 mg and Percocet (acetaminophen/oxycodone). Laboratory data show prediabetes (A1c 6.1%) and chronic anemia (onset 2010) without documented iron therapy. She reports ongoing stress, social isolation, and limited social contact. A medication review has been flagged as overdue since 2020. No prenatal vitamins, iron supplements, or pregnancy‑safe antihypertensives are recorded. The combination of uncontrolled hypertension, unsafe medications, anemia, and psychosocial stressors places both maternal and fetal health at elevated risk.
past_medical_history: Resolved conditions include gingivitis (most recent resolution 2022-04-15), dental filling loss (resolved 2019-03-29), prior resolved stress (2020-03-20), medication review resolved (2019-03-15), two concussions resolved in 2019, viral sinusitis episodes resolved in 2017 and 2019, and a prior normal pregnancy that resolved on 2018-08-10. Additionally, the patient has a documented past pregnancy history of miscarriage (onset 2000-03-24). These reflect a history of dental disease, minor head trauma, prior pregnancy loss, and past stress episodes.

active_medications.name: Ibuprofen 400 MG Oral Tablet
active_medications.purpose: Pain and inflammation from chronic low back pain

active_medications.name: Acetaminophen 325 MG / Oxycodone Hydrochloride 10 MG Oral Tablet (Percocet)
active_medications.purpose: Moderate to severe chronic pain control

social_determinants: Part‑time employment, history of criminal record, social isolation, limited social contact, and higher education. These factors may affect health‑care access, medication adherence, and stress levels.
risk_factor_summary: Blood pressure in stage 2 hypertension (149/98) with an ACE‑inhibitor on board; prediabetic A1c 6.1%; chronic anemia; no BMI, eGFR, lipid panel, or gestational age available. Elevated risk to cardiovascular (preeclampsia, stroke), renal (potential ACE‑inhibitor nephrotoxicity), hematologic (worsening anemia), metabolic (gestational diabetes), and obstetric/fetal systems (teratogenic drug exposure, NSAID/opioid fetal risks). Charlson index 1, clinical complexity moderate.

clinical_impression: Pregnant woman with uncontrolled stage 2 hypertension being treated with a contraindicated ACE‑inhibitor, chronic pain managed with NSAIDs and an opioid, anemia, and prediabetes. Psychosocial stressors and an overdue medication review compound safety concerns for both mother and fetus, highlighting the need for urgent medication reconciliation, transition to pregnancy‑safe antihypertensives, pain management optimization, and comprehensive prenatal care.
